message: HSTS is missing. Non-browser clients (curl, mobile apps, APIs) receive no upgrade protection, and first-time visitors are vulnerable to downgrade attacks before any HSTS cache is established. The header is also required for preload-list eligibility.
notes: Unlike most headers checked here, there's rarely a legitimate reason to omit HSTS on a site that already serves HTTPS — its absence is usually an oversight, not a deliberate trade-off.
